title: [ VX Ace ]Display actor's sprite graphic in battle

posts.author: Midashe
posts.body:
Hello, Midashe here, asking for assistance for the... fourth, fifth time?
I'm in need of a script that doesn't seem to exist. I've been googling many times but can't seem to find anything that fits my criteria. Actually, I'm not even a hundred percent sure if this even needs a script. I think it does but feel free to correct me if I'm wrong.
What I want to do is very simple. Display an actor's sprite graphic in battle... That's pretty much it... Well, I mean, I want complete control over where and how it's displayed. I want to be able to decide its exact position, what direction the actor is facing, which animation frame its on, whether or not its animated and whatever else I might be able to control. I want to be able to do all of that through a script call. The scipt call would look something like 'command_display_actor_sprite(id, actor_id, x, y, direction, animation_frame, animated_true_or_false, etc)' (I don't really know what script calls look like so don't take that example too literally. Also, that first 'id' would be the displayed sprite's id. One could then use another script call to remove the sprite or the same script call with the same id to edit the sprite). This is why I'm not sure whether or not I even need a script for this. Like, does such a script call already exist? Can one use a simple script call to display a sprite in battle? I bet not.
Now, most of you are already coming up with alternative ideas so let me address some of those.
'Why not just take the actor's sprite and make a battler graphic out of it or perhaps a picture?'
That would be because I'm using a script by Neon Black called 'Composite Characters' (Link below). This scipt allows actors to have dynamic graphics (Did I say that right?). This means that the actor's sprite that I want to display in battle will often change. For this reason, I need to be able to grab the actor's current graphic and display that. Preparing graphics beforehand will not work.
'Why not use one of the many sideview battle scripts out there?'
I've looked at many of those and they don't seem to really do what I want. I mean, to begin with, those graphics are attached to the party members, I just want to display an actor's sprite graphic in battle. Secondly, those scripts always have additional features such as specified graphics for death states or animations when attacking or maybe they're just stuck to the side of the screen. I want complete control over where the actor is displayed, when it's displayed, when it's removed, etc.
One thing I actually tried doing was using pictures as layers. Unfortunately, due to the sheer amount of layers I was using (Like 20 or so. The sizes of the pictures probably didn't help either), the game wasn't able to handle it. It ended up seriously lagging and, at one point, even crashed the game. So, that didn't work.
So, there's my request. Honestly, the longer I kept writing this, the more I started thinking that what I'm requesting is probably much bigger than what I think. I'm still holding out hope though that it wouldn't be too complex a script. I mean, there's nothing in it that would be automatic. Everything in it would be determined by the script call... Does that make it more or less complex? I don't know, I can't code to save my life. Anyway, here's to hoping that... Yeah, here's to hoping. Midashe signing out.
Oh, and here's the link to Neon Black's 'Composite Characters' script.

posts.author: Midashe
posts.body: I'm not looking for a sideview battle script. I'm looking for a way to display an actor's sprite in battle. No, that is not the same thing. All those scripts have so many other features that make them as awesome as they are. However, those features are not what I want. I'm using VX Ace's default battle engine, I just want to display an actor's sprite in battle, nothing else. This is why I want the script to use a script call, so that I can decide when the actor's sprite should be displayed, where and how. Those scripts handle all of those things automatically, which gives me less control and makes it impossible for me to use them. I don't want an actor that jumps in joy on victory, I don't want an actor that swings a sword when attacking, I don't want an actor that looks to the left all the time, I want a script that takes a specified actor's sprite graphics and slaps it onto the screen in the middle of battle wherever and however I want it on my command.

posts.author: Midashe
posts.body:
I did try to use the 'Show Picture' action to basically recreate Neon Black's 'Composite Characters' script system. Picture 1 would be the shadow, Picture 2 would be the body, Picture 3 would be the clothes, etc. However, due to the sheer amount of layers that I was creating that way (Like 20 I think it was), the game wasn't able to handle it and lagged a whole bunch and even crashed at one point. My idea is to use Neon Black's script to set up the sprite, put the finished sprite in an actor and then I use another script to take that finished sprite from the actor and display it in a battle. As for when it's displayed and how it acts, that would be entirely up to me. No amount of actions or anything will cause the displayed sprite to react, it'll just sit there as static as... I was gonna say electricity but that stuff doesn't exactly sit still, does it?
Anyway, got any of those Mog scripts? I don't think I'm familiar with those.
